```{r}
# 0. Settings
# ---------------------------
DATA_DIR <- "."
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "A_Cox_outputs")
COMMON_RDS <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "A_Cox_common_data.rds")
EVER_RESULTS_RDS <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "A_Ever_models_and_results.rds")
NEVER_RESULTS_RDS <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "A_Never_models_and_results.rds")

# Stability threshold for PRIMARY substantive interaction levels.
# Every non-reference level in a primary interaction must have at least this
# many deaths in BOTH Dibao groups. The current dataset satisfies this for all
# primary substantive levels. This rule prevents zero-event/quasi-separation
# from silently entering a formal primary interaction test.
MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL <- 5L

dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "csv"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

required_packages <- c("survival", "openxlsx")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

library(survival)
library(openxlsx)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(COMMON_RDS)) {
  stop(
    "A_Cox_common_data.rds was not found at: ", COMMON_RDS, "\n",
    "Run A_Ever_Dibao_Cox_revised.R first."
  )
}

if (!file.exists(EVER_RESULTS_RDS)) {
  stop(
    "A_Ever_models_and_results.rds was not found at: ", EVER_RESULTS_RDS,
    "\nRun A_Ever_Dibao_Cox_revised.R before the interaction analysis."
  )
}

if (!file.exists(NEVER_RESULTS_RDS)) {
  stop(
    "A_Never_models_and_results.rds was not found at: ", NEVER_RESULTS_RDS,
    "\nRun A_Never_Dibao_Cox_revised.R before the interaction analysis."
  )
}

# The interaction model itself uses the common RDS for formal estimation.
# The two group-specific RDS files are also loaded only to export a descriptive
# side-by-side comparison of the already-fitted separate-group main Cox models.
ever_results_object <- readRDS(EVER_RESULTS_RDS)
never_results_object <- readRDS(NEVER_RESULTS_RDS)
```


```{r}
# 1. Helper functions
# ---------------------------
fit_cox_with_warnings <- function(formula, data) {
  warnings_seen <- character(0)

  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    coxph(
      formula,
      data = data,
      ties = "efron",
      cluster = individual_id,
      robust = TRUE,
      x = TRUE,
      model = TRUE
    ),
    warning = function(w) {
      warnings_seen <<- c(warnings_seen, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )

  list(
    fit = fit,
    warnings = unique(warnings_seen)
  )
}

extract_cox_results <- function(fit) {
  s <- summary(fit)
  coef_table <- as.data.frame(s$coefficients)
  ci_table <- as.data.frame(s$conf.int)

  out <- data.frame(
    term = rownames(coef_table),
    beta = coef_table[, "coef"],
    HR = ci_table[, "exp(coef)"],
    lower_95 = ci_table[, "lower .95"],
    upper_95 = ci_table[, "upper .95"],
    p_value = coef_table[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    row.names = NULL,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  if ("robust se" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    out$robust_se <- coef_table[, "robust se"]
  } else if ("se(coef)" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    out$robust_se <- coef_table[, "se(coef)"]
  } else {
    out$robust_se <- NA_real_
  }

  out[, c(
    "term", "beta", "robust_se", "HR",
    "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value"
  )]
}

safe_cox_zph <- function(fit) {
  tryCatch(
    cox.zph(
      fit,
      transform = "km",
      terms = TRUE,
      global = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      structure(
        list(message = conditionMessage(e)),
        class = "cox_zph_error"
      )
    }
  )
}

ph_table <- function(ph_object, model_name) {
  if (inherits(ph_object, "cox_zph_error")) {
    return(data.frame(
      model = model_name,
      term = "PH_TEST_ERROR",
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p = NA_real_,
      message = ph_object$message,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  x <- as.data.frame(ph_object$table)
  x$term <- rownames(x)
  x$model <- model_name
  x$message <- NA_character_
  rownames(x) <- NULL

  x[, c(
    "model", "term",
    setdiff(names(x), c("model", "term"))
  ), drop = FALSE]
}

# PH diagnostic strategy:
# 1) run cox.zph() on the formal clustered-robust Cox fit;
# 2) only if the robust fit is computationally singular for cox.zph(),
#    fit the exact same Cox formula without cluster/robust variance solely for
#    PH diagnostics. The fallback does NOT replace the formal interaction HRs.
run_ph_diagnostic <- function(formula, data, clustered_fit, model_name) {
  primary <- safe_cox_zph(clustered_fit)

  if (!inherits(primary, "cox_zph_error")) {
    tab <- ph_table(primary, model_name)
    tab$diagnostic_source <- "clustered robust Cox fit"
    tab$primary_error <- NA_character_

    return(list(
      object = primary,
      table = tab,
      source = "clustered robust Cox fit",
      primary_error = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  diagnostic_fit <- coxph(
    formula,
    data = data,
    ties = "efron",
    x = TRUE,
    model = TRUE
  )

  fallback <- safe_cox_zph(diagnostic_fit)
  tab <- ph_table(fallback, model_name)
  tab$diagnostic_source <- "same formula, unclustered diagnostic fallback"
  tab$primary_error <- primary$message

  list(
    object = fallback,
    table = tab,
    source = "same formula, unclustered diagnostic fallback",
    primary_error = primary$message
  )
}

# Robust joint Wald test for a block of interaction coefficients.
wald_block <- function(fit, coefficient_names) {
  b_all <- coef(fit)
  coefficient_names <- intersect(coefficient_names, names(b_all))

  if (length(coefficient_names) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = 0L,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      status = "No coefficients found"
    ))
  }

  b <- b_all[coefficient_names]
  V <- vcov(fit)[coefficient_names, coefficient_names, drop = FALSE]

  if (any(!is.finite(b)) || any(!is.finite(V))) {
    return(data.frame(
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = length(coefficient_names),
      p_value = NA_real_,
      status = "Non-finite coefficient/variance; inspect sparse cells"
    ))
  }

  ee <- eigen(V, symmetric = TRUE)
  tol <- max(abs(ee$values)) * 1e-10
  keep <- ee$values > tol

  if (!any(keep)) {
    return(data.frame(
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = 0L,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      status = "Robust covariance block has rank 0"
    ))
  }

  Vinv <- ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE] %*%
    diag(1 / ee$values[keep], nrow = sum(keep)) %*%
    t(ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE])

  W <- as.numeric(t(b) %*% Vinv %*% b)
  df <- sum(keep)
  p <- pchisq(W, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)

  data.frame(
    chisq = W,
    df = df,
    p_value = p,
    status = ifelse(
      df < length(coefficient_names),
      "Reduced-rank robust Wald test",
      "OK"
    )
  )
}

single_coefficient_stats <- function(fit, term) {
  b <- coef(fit)
  V <- vcov(fit)

  if (!(term %in% names(b)) || !is.finite(b[term])) {
    return(c(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  if (!is.finite(V[term, term])) {
    return(c(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  est <- unname(b[term])
  se <- sqrt(V[term, term])
  p <- 2 * pnorm(abs(est / se), lower.tail = FALSE)

  c(est = est, se = se, p = p)
}

linear_combination_stats <- function(fit, weights) {
  b <- coef(fit)
  V <- vcov(fit)
  needed <- names(weights)

  if (any(!(needed %in% names(b)))) {
    return(c(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  if (any(!is.finite(b[needed])) ||
      any(!is.finite(V[needed, needed, drop = FALSE]))) {
    return(c(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  w <- rep(0, length(b))
  names(w) <- names(b)
  w[needed] <- weights

  est <- sum(w * b)
  se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(w) %*% V %*% w))
  p <- 2 * pnorm(abs(est / se), lower.tail = FALSE)

  c(est = est, se = se, p = p)
}

stats_to_hr <- function(stats) {
  est <- unname(stats["est"])
  se <- unname(stats["se"])
  p <- unname(stats["p"])

  if (!is.finite(est) || !is.finite(se)) {
    return(c(
      HR = NA_real_, lower_95 = NA_real_, upper_95 = NA_real_, p = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  c(
    HR = exp(est),
    lower_95 = exp(est - 1.96 * se),
    upper_95 = exp(est + 1.96 * se),
    p = p
  )
}

safe_name <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+$", "", x)
  x
}

add_interaction_columns <- function(data, variable, levels_to_interact) {
  int_names <- character(0)
  level_map <- data.frame(
    variable = character(0),
    level = character(0),
    interaction_term = character(0),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (lev in levels_to_interact) {
    nm <- paste0("int_", variable, "_", safe_name(lev))

    data[[nm]] <- as.integer(
      as.character(data$dibao_group) == "Ever" &
        as.character(data[[variable]]) == lev
    )

    int_names <- c(int_names, nm)
    level_map <- rbind(
      level_map,
      data.frame(
        variable = variable,
        level = lev,
        interaction_term = nm,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  list(
    data = data,
    interaction_names = int_names,
    level_map = level_map
  )
}

build_formula <- function(interaction_names) {
  base_covariates <- c(
    "sex",
    "income_tertile",
    "marriage_status",
    "living_children",
    "coresident_child"
  )

  rhs <- c(
    base_covariates,
    interaction_names,
    "strata(age_group, dibao_group)"
  )

  as.formula(
    paste(
      "Surv(start, stop, event) ~",
      paste(rhs, collapse = " + ")
    )
  )
}

main_coefficient_name <- function(variable, level) {
  paste0(variable, level)
}

comparison_label <- function(variable, level) {
  refs <- c(
    sex = "Male",
    income_tertile = "T1",
    marriage_status = "Partnered",
    living_children = "0",
    coresident_child = "No"
  )

  variable_label <- c(
    sex = "Sex",
    income_tertile = "Income",
    marriage_status = "Marriage",
    living_children = "Living children",
    coresident_child = "Coresident child"
  )

  paste0(
    variable_label[[variable]], ": ",
    level, " vs ", refs[[variable]]
  )
}

make_level_hr_row <- function(fit, variable, level, interaction_term) {
  main_term <- main_coefficient_name(variable, level)

  never_stats <- single_coefficient_stats(fit, main_term)
  ever_stats <- linear_combination_stats(
    fit,
    setNames(c(1, 1), c(main_term, interaction_term))
  )
  ratio_stats <- single_coefficient_stats(fit, interaction_term)

  never_hr <- stats_to_hr(never_stats)
  ever_hr <- stats_to_hr(ever_stats)
  ratio_hr <- stats_to_hr(ratio_stats)

  data.frame(
    factor = variable,
    comparison = comparison_label(variable, level),
    Never_HR = never_hr["HR"],
    Never_lower_95 = never_hr["lower_95"],
    Never_upper_95 = never_hr["upper_95"],
    Never_p = never_hr["p"],
    Ever_HR = ever_hr["HR"],
    Ever_lower_95 = ever_hr["lower_95"],
    Ever_upper_95 = ever_hr["upper_95"],
    Ever_p = ever_hr["p"],
    HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never = ratio_hr["HR"],
    ratio_lower_95 = ratio_hr["lower_95"],
    ratio_upper_95 = ratio_hr["upper_95"],
    interaction_p = ratio_hr["p"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

make_readable_interaction <- function(x) {
  out <- x

  out$Never_HR_95CI <- ifelse(
    is.na(out$Never_HR),
    NA_character_,
    sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)",
      out$Never_HR, out$Never_lower_95, out$Never_upper_95
    )
  )

  out$Ever_HR_95CI <- ifelse(
    is.na(out$Ever_HR),
    NA_character_,
    sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)",
      out$Ever_HR, out$Ever_lower_95, out$Ever_upper_95
    )
  )

  out$HR_ratio_95CI <- ifelse(
    is.na(out$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never),
    NA_character_,
    sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)",
      out$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never,
      out$ratio_lower_95,
      out$ratio_upper_95
    )
  )

  out$interaction_p_display <- ifelse(
    is.na(out$interaction_p),
    NA_character_,
    ifelse(
      out$interaction_p < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
      sprintf("%.3f", out$interaction_p)
    )
  )

  out[, c(
    "factor",
    "comparison",
    "Never_HR_95CI",
    "Ever_HR_95CI",
    "HR_ratio_95CI",
    "interaction_p_display",
    "Never_HR", "Never_lower_95", "Never_upper_95", "Never_p",
    "Ever_HR", "Ever_lower_95", "Ever_upper_95", "Ever_p",
    "HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never", "ratio_lower_95", "ratio_upper_95",
    "interaction_p"
  )]
}

make_group_level_qa <- function(data, variable) {
  levs <- levels(data[[variable]])
  groups <- levels(data$dibao_group)

  grid <- expand.grid(
    dibao_group = groups,
    level = levs,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  out <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
    gr <- grid$dibao_group[i]
    lev <- grid$level[i]

    d <- data[
      as.character(data$dibao_group) == gr &
        as.character(data[[variable]]) == lev,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    data.frame(
      dibao_group = gr,
      variable = variable,
      level = lev,
      records = nrow(d),
      persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  do.call(rbind, out)
}

check_nonoverlap <- function(data) {
  ids <- unique(data$individual_id)
  bad <- character(0)

  for (id in ids) {
    d <- data[data$individual_id == id, , drop = FALSE]
    d <- d[order(d$start, d$stop), , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(d) > 1) {
      overlap <- d$start[-1] < d$stop[-nrow(d)]
      if (any(overlap, na.rm = TRUE)) {
        bad <- c(bad, id)
      }
    }
  }

  unique(bad)
}

print_table_section <- function(title, x, digits = 4) {
  cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 78), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(title, "\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 78), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")

  if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) {
    cat("No result available.\n")
  } else {
    print(x, row.names = FALSE, digits = digits)
  }
}

add_sheet <- function(wb, name, x) {
  addWorksheet(wb, name)
  writeData(wb, name, x)
}

# ---------------------------
# 2. Read and validate common Method A data
# ---------------------------
common <- readRDS(COMMON_RDS)

required_common_objects <- c(
  "analysis_intervals",
  "income_cutoffs"
)

missing_common_objects <- setdiff(
  required_common_objects,
  names(common)
)

if (length(missing_common_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The common RDS is missing required object(s): ",
    paste(missing_common_objects, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

dat_all <- common$analysis_intervals

required_columns <- c(
  "individual_id",
  "household_id",
  "dibao_group",
  "start",
  "stop",
  "event",
  "person_years",
  "sex",
  "income_tertile",
  "long_mean_household_income_pc",
  "marriage_status",
  "living_children",
  "coresident_child",
  "age_group"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(dat_all))

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "analysis_intervals is missing required column(s): ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (length(common$income_cutoffs) != 2 ||
    any(!is.finite(common$income_cutoffs))) {
  stop("The common RDS does not contain two valid finite income cutoffs.")
}

q1 <- as.numeric(common$income_cutoffs[1])
q2 <- as.numeric(common$income_cutoffs[2])

if (!(q1 < q2)) {
  stop("Income cutoffs are invalid: q1 must be smaller than q2.")
}

# Keep only the two formal analysis groups.
dat_all <- dat_all[
  as.character(dat_all$dibao_group) %in% c("Never", "Ever"),
  , drop = FALSE
]

if (nrow(dat_all) == 0) {
  stop("No Ever/Never analysis intervals found in the common RDS.")
}

# Basic person-period integrity checks.
if (any(is.na(dat_all$start)) || any(is.na(dat_all$stop))) {
  stop("Interaction data contain missing start or stop times.")
}

if (any(dat_all$stop <= dat_all$start)) {
  stop("Interaction data contain stop <= start intervals.")
}

if (any(!dat_all$event %in% c(0, 1))) {
  stop("Interaction data contain event values other than 0/1.")
}

events_per_person <- tapply(
  dat_all$event,
  dat_all$individual_id,
  sum,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

if (any(events_per_person > 1)) {
  stop("At least one participant has more than one death event.")
}

bad_overlap <- check_nonoverlap(dat_all)

if (length(bad_overlap) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Overlapping person-period intervals detected for ",
    length(bad_overlap),
    " participant(s). First IDs: ",
    paste(head(bad_overlap, 10), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# 3. Match the revised Ever/Never model sample definition
# ---------------------------
# Marriage Unknown was excluded from BOTH revised separate-group Cox models
# because it created severe sparse/zero-event instability. The interaction
# analysis must therefore use the same rule for both groups.
marriage_unknown_excluded <- dat_all[
  as.character(dat_all$marriage_status) == "Unknown",
  , drop = FALSE
]

dat <- dat_all[
  as.character(dat_all$marriage_status) != "Unknown",
  , drop = FALSE
]

dat <- droplevels(dat)

# Re-assert factor order and reference categories.
dat$dibao_group <- factor(
  dat$dibao_group,
  levels = c("Never", "Ever")
)

dat$sex <- factor(
  dat$sex,
  levels = c("Male", "Female")
)

dat$income_tertile <- factor(
  dat$income_tertile,
  levels = c("T1", "T2", "T3")
)

dat$marriage_status <- factor(
  dat$marriage_status,
  levels = c(
    "Partnered",
    "Widowed",
    "Separated-Divorced",
    "Never married"
  )
)

dat$living_children <- factor(
  dat$living_children,
  levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+", "Unknown")
)

dat$coresident_child <- factor(
  dat$coresident_child,
  levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")
)

dat$age_group <- factor(
  dat$age_group,
  levels = c("45-54", "55-64", "65-74", "75-84", "85-94", "95+")
)

# Required modeled fields must be present after filtering/re-leveling.
for (v in c(
  "dibao_group", "sex", "income_tertile", "marriage_status",
  "living_children", "coresident_child", "age_group"
)) {
  if (any(is.na(dat[[v]]))) {
    stop("Unexpected missing/invalid value in final interaction variable: ", v)
  }
}

if (length(unique(dat$dibao_group)) != 2) {
  stop("Both Never and Ever groups are required for interaction testing.")
}

if (sum(dat$event, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
  stop("No death events remain in the interaction analysis data.")
}
```

```{r}
# 4. Sample summary and QA
# ---------------------------
sample_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
    d <- dat[as.character(dat$dibao_group) == gr, , drop = FALSE]

    data.frame(
      dibao_group = gr,
      persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      households = length(unique(d$household_id)),
      person_intervals = nrow(d),
      person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
      death_events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

marriage_unknown_exclusion_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
    d <- marriage_unknown_excluded[
      as.character(marriage_unknown_excluded$dibao_group) == gr,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    data.frame(
      dibao_group = gr,
      rule = "Marriage status Unknown excluded from formal interaction models",
      records_excluded = nrow(d),
      persons_affected = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      events_excluded = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_years_excluded = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

income_cutoff_table <- data.frame(
  cutoff = c("33.333%", "66.667%"),
  value = c(q1, q2),
  method = "Same Method A common cutoffs generated by revised Ever script",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

qa_variables <- c(
  "sex",
  "income_tertile",
  "marriage_status",
  "living_children",
  "coresident_child",
  "age_group"
)

cell_qa <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(qa_variables, function(v) make_group_level_qa(dat, v))
)

sparse_qa <- cell_qa[
  cell_qa$events < MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL,
  , drop = FALSE
]

# ---------------------------
# 5. Define primary and sensitivity interaction specifications
# ---------------------------
# PRIMARY substantive interaction levels.
# Unknown missingness categories remain in the adjustment set but are not
# included in the primary substantive heterogeneity test.
primary_specs <- list(
  sex = c("Female"),
  income_tertile = c("T2", "T3"),
  marriage_status = c("Widowed", "Separated-Divorced", "Never married"),
  living_children = c("1", "2", "3+"),
  coresident_child = c("Yes")
)

# ALL-LEVEL sensitivity interaction levels.
# Here Unknown is additionally interacted for children and coresidence.
all_level_specs <- list(
  sex = c("Female"),
  income_tertile = c("T2", "T3"),
  marriage_status = c("Widowed", "Separated-Divorced", "Never married"),
  living_children = c("1", "2", "3+", "Unknown"),
  coresident_child = c("Yes", "Unknown")
)

# ---------------------------
# 6. Verify primary interaction cells before fitting
# ---------------------------
primary_eligibility <- data.frame()

for (target in names(primary_specs)) {
  for (lev in primary_specs[[target]]) {
    z <- cell_qa[
      cell_qa$variable == target &
        cell_qa$level == lev &
        cell_qa$dibao_group %in% c("Never", "Ever"),
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    never_events <- if (any(z$dibao_group == "Never")) {
      z$events[z$dibao_group == "Never"][1]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    ever_events <- if (any(z$dibao_group == "Ever")) {
      z$events[z$dibao_group == "Ever"][1]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    eligible <- !is.na(never_events) && !is.na(ever_events) &&
      never_events >= MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL &&
      ever_events >= MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL

    primary_eligibility <- rbind(
      primary_eligibility,
      data.frame(
        factor = target,
        level = lev,
        Never_events = never_events,
        Ever_events = ever_events,
        eligible = eligible,
        rule = paste0(
          ">=", MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL,
          " deaths in both Dibao groups"
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
}

if (any(!primary_eligibility$eligible)) {
  bad <- primary_eligibility[!primary_eligibility$eligible, , drop = FALSE]
  stop(
    "At least one PRIMARY substantive interaction level does not meet the ",
    "prespecified event-count stability rule. Inspect primary_eligibility.\n",
    paste(
      paste0(
        bad$factor, " / ", bad$level,
        " (Never events=", bad$Never_events,
        ", Ever events=", bad$Ever_events, ")"
      ),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}
```


```{r}
# 7. Function to fit one-factor-at-a-time interaction models
# ---------------------------
fit_interaction_set <- function(data, specs, analysis_label) {
  models <- list()
  block_tests <- data.frame()
  level_HRs <- data.frame()
  coefficients <- data.frame()
  ph_tables <- data.frame()
  ph_objects <- list()
  warnings_table <- data.frame()

  for (target in names(specs)) {
    tmp <- add_interaction_columns(
      data,
      target,
      specs[[target]]
    )

    model_data <- tmp$data
    int_names <- tmp$interaction_names
    level_map <- tmp$level_map
    form <- build_formula(int_names)

    fit_obj <- fit_cox_with_warnings(form, model_data)
    fit <- fit_obj$fit

    model_name <- paste0(analysis_label, "_", target)
    models[[target]] <- fit

    # Robust block Wald test: H0 = all interaction coefficients for target = 0.
    block <- wald_block(fit, int_names)
    block$analysis <- analysis_label
    block$factor <- target
    block$n_interaction_terms <- length(int_names)

    block_tests <- rbind(
      block_tests,
      block[, c(
        "analysis", "factor", "chisq", "df", "p_value",
        "n_interaction_terms", "status"
      )]
    )

    # All model coefficients.
    cc <- extract_cox_results(fit)
    cc$analysis <- analysis_label
    cc$factor_tested <- target

    coefficients <- rbind(
      coefficients,
      cc[, c(
        "analysis", "factor_tested",
        setdiff(names(cc), c("analysis", "factor_tested"))
      )]
    )

    # Level-specific Never HR, Ever HR, and Ever/Never HR ratio.
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(level_map))) {
      rr <- make_level_hr_row(
        fit = fit,
        variable = target,
        level = level_map$level[j],
        interaction_term = level_map$interaction_term[j]
      )
      rr$analysis <- analysis_label

      level_HRs <- rbind(
        level_HRs,
        rr[, c("analysis", setdiff(names(rr), "analysis"))]
      )
    }

    # PH diagnostics.
    ph_diag <- run_ph_diagnostic(
      form,
      model_data,
      fit,
      model_name
    )

    ph_objects[[target]] <- ph_diag$object
    ph_tables <- rbind(ph_tables, ph_diag$table)

    # Capture coxph warnings.
    if (length(fit_obj$warnings) > 0) {
      warnings_table <- rbind(
        warnings_table,
        data.frame(
          analysis = analysis_label,
          model = target,
          warning = fit_obj$warnings,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      )
    }
  }

  list(
    models = models,
    block_tests = block_tests,
    level_HRs = level_HRs,
    coefficients = coefficients,
    ph_tables = ph_tables,
    ph_objects = ph_objects,
    warnings = warnings_table
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# 8. PRIMARY one-factor-at-a-time substantive interaction models
# ---------------------------
primary_results <- fit_interaction_set(
  data = dat,
  specs = primary_specs,
  analysis_label = "Primary_Substantive"
)

primary_level_readable <- make_readable_interaction(
  primary_results$level_HRs
)

# ---------------------------
# 9. ALL-LEVEL one-factor-at-a-time sensitivity models
# ---------------------------
all_level_results <- fit_interaction_set(
  data = dat,
  specs = all_level_specs,
  analysis_label = "Sensitivity_AllLevels"
)

all_level_readable <- make_readable_interaction(
  all_level_results$level_HRs
)

# ---------------------------
# 10. Full interaction model helper
# ---------------------------
fit_full_interaction_model <- function(data, specs, analysis_label) {
  full_data <- data
  full_blocks <- list()
  full_level_map <- list()
  all_interaction_names <- character(0)

  for (target in names(specs)) {
    tmp <- add_interaction_columns(
      full_data,
      target,
      specs[[target]]
    )

    full_data <- tmp$data
    full_blocks[[target]] <- tmp$interaction_names
    full_level_map[[target]] <- tmp$level_map
    all_interaction_names <- c(
      all_interaction_names,
      tmp$interaction_names
    )
  }

  full_formula <- build_formula(all_interaction_names)
  fit_obj <- fit_cox_with_warnings(full_formula, full_data)
  fit <- fit_obj$fit

  block_tests <- data.frame()
  level_HRs <- data.frame()

  for (target in names(specs)) {
    int_names <- full_blocks[[target]]
    block <- wald_block(fit, int_names)
    block$analysis <- analysis_label
    block$factor <- target
    block$n_interaction_terms <- length(int_names)

    block_tests <- rbind(
      block_tests,
      block[, c(
        "analysis", "factor", "chisq", "df", "p_value",
        "n_interaction_terms", "status"
      )]
    )

    lm <- full_level_map[[target]]

    for (j in seq_len(nrow(lm))) {
      rr <- make_level_hr_row(
        fit = fit,
        variable = target,
        level = lm$level[j],
        interaction_term = lm$interaction_term[j]
      )
      rr$analysis <- analysis_label

      level_HRs <- rbind(
        level_HRs,
        rr[, c("analysis", setdiff(names(rr), "analysis"))]
      )
    }
  }

  coefficients <- extract_cox_results(fit)
  coefficients$analysis <- analysis_label
  coefficients <- coefficients[, c(
    "analysis", setdiff(names(coefficients), "analysis")
  )]

  ph_diag <- run_ph_diagnostic(
    full_formula,
    full_data,
    fit,
    analysis_label
  )

  warning_table <- if (length(fit_obj$warnings) > 0) {
    data.frame(
      analysis = analysis_label,
      model = "Full interaction model",
      warning = fit_obj$warnings,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }

  list(
    model = fit,
    formula = full_formula,
    block_tests = block_tests,
    level_HRs = level_HRs,
    level_HRs_readable = make_readable_interaction(level_HRs),
    coefficients = coefficients,
    ph = ph_diag$object,
    ph_table = ph_diag$table,
    warnings = warning_table
  )
}
```

```{r}
  data = dat,
  specs = primary_specs,

full_all_levels <- fit_full_interaction_model(
  data = dat,
  specs = all_level_specs,
  analysis_label = "Full_AllLevels"
)

# ---------------------------
# 13. Interaction-cell QA and sensitivity flags
# ---------------------------
# The all-level sensitivity model may contain low-event Unknown categories.
# Flag them explicitly; do not silently interpret them as stable substantive
# effects.
all_level_interaction_qa <- data.frame()

for (target in names(all_level_specs)) {
  for (lev in all_level_specs[[target]]) {
    z <- cell_qa[
      cell_qa$variable == target &
        cell_qa$level == lev &
        cell_qa$dibao_group %in% c("Never", "Ever"),
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    never_events <- if (any(z$dibao_group == "Never")) {
      z$events[z$dibao_group == "Never"][1]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    ever_events <- if (any(z$dibao_group == "Ever")) {
      z$events[z$dibao_group == "Ever"][1]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    all_level_interaction_qa <- rbind(
      all_level_interaction_qa,
      data.frame(
        factor = target,
        level = lev,
        Never_events = never_events,
        Ever_events = ever_events,
        low_event_flag =
          is.na(never_events) || is.na(ever_events) ||
          never_events < MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL ||
          ever_events < MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
}

# ---------------------------
# 14. Side-by-side independent group results (descriptive only)
# ---------------------------
# These are NOT the formal interaction results. They are included only to help
# the reader compare the separately fitted Ever and Never main Cox models.
independent_group_comparison <- data.frame()

if (!is.null(ever_results_object) &&
    !is.null(ever_results_object$main_results_readable) &&
    !is.null(never_results_object$main_results_readable)) {

  ev <- ever_results_object$main_results_readable
  nv <- never_results_object$main_results_readable

  ev2 <- ev[, c("comparison", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")]
  nv2 <- nv[, c("comparison", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")]

  names(ev2)[-1] <- paste0("Ever_", names(ev2)[-1])
  names(nv2)[-1] <- paste0("Never_", names(nv2)[-1])

  independent_group_comparison <- merge(
    nv2,
    ev2,
    by = "comparison",
    all = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# 15. Combine warnings
# ---------------------------
model_warning_table <- rbind(
  primary_results$warnings,
  all_level_results$warnings,
  full_substantive$warnings,
  full_all_levels$warnings
)

if (nrow(model_warning_table) == 0) {

    analysis = "None",

  )
}

# ---------------------------

# One PDF for each PRIMARY substantive interaction model.
for (target in names(primary_results$models)) {
  ph <- primary_results$ph_objects[[target]]

  if (!inherits(ph, "cox_zph_error")) {

}
```

```{r}
# Method A: Ever-vs-Never Dibao interaction analysis, including HUKOU.
# HUKOU: 1=agricultural; 2=non-agricultural (reference).
# Fixed at each participant's first non-missing wave in the common RDS.
# Uses the ALREADY generated Phase 1 common + group model RDS files.
# Run from the same working directory as Phase 1; no CSV reread/cleaning.
# Formal models are not executed by preparing this script.

# 0. Settings
# ---------------------------
DATA_DIR <- "."
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "A_Cox_outputs")
COMMON_RDS <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "A_Cox_common_data.rds")
EVER_RESULTS_RDS <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "A_Ever_models_and_results.rds")
NEVER_RESULTS_RDS <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "A_Never_models_and_results.rds")

# Stability threshold for PRIMARY substantive interaction levels.
# Every non-reference level in a primary interaction must have at least this
# many deaths in BOTH Dibao groups. The current dataset satisfies this for all
# primary substantive levels. This rule prevents zero-event/quasi-separation
# from silently entering a formal primary interaction test.
MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL <- 5L

dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "csv"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

required_packages <- c("survival", "openxlsx")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

library(survival)
library(openxlsx)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(COMMON_RDS)) {
  stop(
    "A_Cox_common_data.rds was not found at: ", COMMON_RDS, "\n",
    "Run the updated Ever Dibao HUKOU script to create it first."
  )
}

if (!file.exists(EVER_RESULTS_RDS)) {
  stop(
    "A_Ever_models_and_results.rds was not found at: ", EVER_RESULTS_RDS,
    "\nThe updated Ever Dibao HUKOU model RDS is required."
  )
}

if (!file.exists(NEVER_RESULTS_RDS)) {
  stop(
    "A_Never_models_and_results.rds was not found at: ", NEVER_RESULTS_RDS,
    "\nThe updated Never Dibao HUKOU model RDS is required."
  )
}

# The interaction model itself uses the common RDS for formal estimation.
# The two group-specific RDS files are also loaded only to export a descriptive
# side-by-side comparison of the already-fitted separate-group main Cox models.
ever_results_object <- readRDS(EVER_RESULTS_RDS)
never_results_object <- readRDS(NEVER_RESULTS_RDS)

# Reject old Phase 1 model results that predate the HUKOU adjustment.
for (group_object in list(
  Ever = ever_results_object,
  Never = never_results_object
)) {
  if (is.null(group_object$main_model) ||
      is.null(group_object$main_results) ||
      is.null(group_object$main_results_readable) ||
      !("hukouAgricultural" %in% group_object$main_results$term)) {
    stop(
      "A Phase 1 result RDS is missing the adjusted HUKOU main model. ",
      "Use the already generated NEW Ever/Never HUKOU RDS files."
    )
  }
}

# 1. Helper functions
# ---------------------------
fit_cox_with_warnings <- function(formula, data) {
  warnings_seen <- character(0)

  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    coxph(
      formula,
      data = data,
      ties = "efron",
      cluster = individual_id,
      robust = TRUE,
      x = TRUE,
      model = TRUE
    ),
    warning = function(w) {
      warnings_seen <<- c(warnings_seen, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )

  list(
    fit = fit,
    warnings = unique(warnings_seen)
  )
}

extract_cox_results <- function(fit) {
  s <- summary(fit)
  coef_table <- as.data.frame(s$coefficients)
  ci_table <- as.data.frame(s$conf.int)

  out <- data.frame(
    term = rownames(coef_table),
    beta = coef_table[, "coef"],
    HR = ci_table[, "exp(coef)"],
    lower_95 = ci_table[, "lower .95"],
    upper_95 = ci_table[, "upper .95"],
    p_value = coef_table[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    row.names = NULL,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  if ("robust se" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    out$robust_se <- coef_table[, "robust se"]
  } else if ("se(coef)" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    out$robust_se <- coef_table[, "se(coef)"]
  } else {
    out$robust_se <- NA_real_
  }

  out[, c(
    "term", "beta", "robust_se", "HR",
    "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value"
  )]
}

safe_cox_zph <- function(fit) {
  tryCatch(
    cox.zph(
      fit,
      transform = "km",
      terms = TRUE,
      global = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      structure(
        list(message = conditionMessage(e)),
        class = "cox_zph_error"
      )
    }
  )
}

ph_table <- function(ph_object, model_name) {
  if (inherits(ph_object, "cox_zph_error")) {
    return(data.frame(
      model = model_name,
      term = "PH_TEST_ERROR",
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p = NA_real_,
      message = ph_object$message,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  x <- as.data.frame(ph_object$table)
  x$term <- rownames(x)
  x$model <- model_name
  x$message <- NA_character_
  rownames(x) <- NULL

  x[, c(
    "model", "term",
    setdiff(names(x), c("model", "term"))
  ), drop = FALSE]
}

# PH diagnostic strategy:
# 1) run cox.zph() on the formal clustered-robust Cox fit;
# 2) only if the robust fit is computationally singular for cox.zph(),
#    fit the exact same Cox formula without cluster/robust variance solely for
#    PH diagnostics. The fallback does NOT replace the formal interaction HRs.
run_ph_diagnostic <- function(formula, data, clustered_fit, model_name) {
  primary <- safe_cox_zph(clustered_fit)

  if (!inherits(primary, "cox_zph_error")) {
    tab <- ph_table(primary, model_name)
    tab$diagnostic_source <- "clustered robust Cox fit"
    tab$primary_error <- NA_character_

    return(list(
      object = primary,
      table = tab,
      source = "clustered robust Cox fit",
      primary_error = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  diagnostic_fit <- tryCatch(
    coxph(
      formula,
      data = data,
      ties = "efron",
      x = TRUE,
      model = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  fallback <- if (inherits(diagnostic_fit, "error")) {
    structure(list(message = conditionMessage(diagnostic_fit)),
              class = "cox_zph_error")
  } else {
    safe_cox_zph(diagnostic_fit)
  }
  tab <- ph_table(fallback, model_name)
  tab$diagnostic_source <- "same formula, unclustered diagnostic fallback"
  tab$primary_error <- primary$message

  list(
    object = fallback,
    table = tab,
    source = "same formula, unclustered diagnostic fallback",
    primary_error = primary$message
  )
}

# Robust joint Wald test for a block of interaction coefficients.
wald_block <- function(fit, coefficient_names) {
  b_all <- coef(fit)
  coefficient_names <- intersect(coefficient_names, names(b_all))

  if (length(coefficient_names) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = 0L,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      status = "No coefficients found"
    ))
  }

  b <- b_all[coefficient_names]
  V <- vcov(fit)[coefficient_names, coefficient_names, drop = FALSE]

  if (any(!is.finite(b)) || any(!is.finite(V))) {
    return(data.frame(
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = length(coefficient_names),
      p_value = NA_real_,
      status = "Non-finite coefficient/variance; inspect sparse cells"
    ))
  }

  ee <- eigen(V, symmetric = TRUE)
  tol <- max(abs(ee$values)) * 1e-10
  keep <- ee$values > tol

  if (!any(keep)) {
    return(data.frame(
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = 0L,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      status = "Robust covariance block has rank 0"
    ))
  }

  Vinv <- ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE] %*%
    diag(1 / ee$values[keep], nrow = sum(keep)) %*%
    t(ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE])

  W <- as.numeric(t(b) %*% Vinv %*% b)
  df <- sum(keep)
  p <- pchisq(W, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)

  data.frame(
    chisq = W,
    df = df,
    p_value = p,
    status = ifelse(
      df < length(coefficient_names),
      "Reduced-rank robust Wald test",
      "OK"
    )
  )
}

single_coefficient_stats <- function(fit, term) {
  b <- coef(fit)
  V <- vcov(fit)

  if (!(term %in% names(b)) || !is.finite(b[term])) {
    return(c(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  if (!is.finite(V[term, term])) {
    return(c(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  est <- unname(b[term])
  se <- sqrt(V[term, term])
  p <- 2 * pnorm(abs(est / se), lower.tail = FALSE)

  c(est = est, se = se, p = p)
}

linear_combination_stats <- function(fit, weights) {
  b <- coef(fit)
  V <- vcov(fit)
  needed <- names(weights)

  if (any(!(needed %in% names(b)))) {
    return(c(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  if (any(!is.finite(b[needed])) ||
      any(!is.finite(V[needed, needed, drop = FALSE]))) {
    return(c(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  w <- rep(0, length(b))
  names(w) <- names(b)
  w[needed] <- weights

  est <- sum(w * b)
  se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(w) %*% V %*% w))
  p <- 2 * pnorm(abs(est / se), lower.tail = FALSE)

  c(est = est, se = se, p = p)
}

stats_to_hr <- function(stats) {
  est <- unname(stats["est"])
  se <- unname(stats["se"])
  p <- unname(stats["p"])

  if (!is.finite(est) || !is.finite(se)) {
    return(c(
      HR = NA_real_, lower_95 = NA_real_, upper_95 = NA_real_, p = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  c(
    HR = exp(est),
    lower_95 = exp(est - 1.96 * se),
    upper_95 = exp(est + 1.96 * se),
    p = p
  )
}

safe_name <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+$", "", x)
  x
}

add_interaction_columns <- function(data, variable, levels_to_interact) {
  int_names <- character(0)
  level_map <- data.frame(
    variable = character(0),
    level = character(0),
    interaction_term = character(0),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (lev in levels_to_interact) {
    nm <- paste0("int_", variable, "_", safe_name(lev))

    data[[nm]] <- as.integer(
      as.character(data$dibao_group) == "Ever" &
        as.character(data[[variable]]) == lev
    )

    int_names <- c(int_names, nm)
    level_map <- rbind(
      level_map,
      data.frame(
        variable = variable,
        level = lev,
        interaction_term = nm,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  list(
    data = data,
    interaction_names = int_names,
    level_map = level_map
  )
}

build_formula <- function(interaction_names) {
  # All six Phase 1 factors are adjusted in EVERY pooled model.
  base_covariates <- c(
    "sex",
    "income_tertile",
    "marriage_status",
    "living_children",
    "coresident_child",
    "hukou"
  )

  rhs <- c(
    base_covariates,
    interaction_names,
    "strata(age_group, dibao_group)"
  )

  as.formula(
    paste(
      "Surv(start, stop, event) ~",
      paste(rhs, collapse = " + ")
    )
  )
}

main_coefficient_name <- function(variable, level) {
  paste0(variable, level)
}

comparison_label <- function(variable, level) {
  refs <- c(
    sex = "Male",
    income_tertile = "T1",
    marriage_status = "Partnered",
    living_children = "0",
    coresident_child = "No",
    hukou = "Non-agricultural"
  )

  variable_label <- c(
    sex = "Sex",
    income_tertile = "Income",
    marriage_status = "Marriage",
    living_children = "Living children",
    coresident_child = "Coresident child",
    hukou = "HUKOU"
  )

  paste0(
    variable_label[[variable]], ": ",
    level, " vs ", refs[[variable]]
  )
}

make_level_hr_row <- function(fit, variable, level, interaction_term) {
  main_term <- main_coefficient_name(variable, level)

  never_stats <- single_coefficient_stats(fit, main_term)
  ever_stats <- linear_combination_stats(
    fit,
    setNames(c(1, 1), c(main_term, interaction_term))
  )
  ratio_stats <- single_coefficient_stats(fit, interaction_term)

  never_hr <- stats_to_hr(never_stats)
  ever_hr <- stats_to_hr(ever_stats)
  ratio_hr <- stats_to_hr(ratio_stats)

  data.frame(
    factor = variable,
    comparison = comparison_label(variable, level),
    Never_HR = never_hr["HR"],
    Never_lower_95 = never_hr["lower_95"],
    Never_upper_95 = never_hr["upper_95"],
    Never_p = never_hr["p"],
    Ever_HR = ever_hr["HR"],
    Ever_lower_95 = ever_hr["lower_95"],
    Ever_upper_95 = ever_hr["upper_95"],
    Ever_p = ever_hr["p"],
    HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never = ratio_hr["HR"],
    ratio_lower_95 = ratio_hr["lower_95"],
    ratio_upper_95 = ratio_hr["upper_95"],
    interaction_p = ratio_hr["p"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

make_readable_interaction <- function(x) {
  out <- x

  out$Never_HR_95CI <- ifelse(
    is.na(out$Never_HR),
    NA_character_,
    sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)",
      out$Never_HR, out$Never_lower_95, out$Never_upper_95
    )
  )

  out$Ever_HR_95CI <- ifelse(
    is.na(out$Ever_HR),
    NA_character_,
    sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)",
      out$Ever_HR, out$Ever_lower_95, out$Ever_upper_95
    )
  )

  out$HR_ratio_95CI <- ifelse(
    is.na(out$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never),
    NA_character_,
    sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)",
      out$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never,
      out$ratio_lower_95,
      out$ratio_upper_95
    )
  )

  out$interaction_p_display <- ifelse(
    is.na(out$interaction_p),
    NA_character_,
    ifelse(
      out$interaction_p < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
      sprintf("%.3f", out$interaction_p)
    )
  )

  out[, c(
    "factor",
    "comparison",
    "Never_HR_95CI",
    "Ever_HR_95CI",
    "HR_ratio_95CI",
    "interaction_p_display",
    "Never_HR", "Never_lower_95", "Never_upper_95", "Never_p",
    "Ever_HR", "Ever_lower_95", "Ever_upper_95", "Ever_p",
    "HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never", "ratio_lower_95", "ratio_upper_95",
    "interaction_p"
  )]
}

make_group_level_qa <- function(data, variable) {
  levs <- levels(data[[variable]])
  groups <- levels(data$dibao_group)

  grid <- expand.grid(
    dibao_group = groups,
    level = levs,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  out <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
    gr <- grid$dibao_group[i]
    lev <- grid$level[i]

    d <- data[
      as.character(data$dibao_group) == gr &
        as.character(data[[variable]]) == lev,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    data.frame(
      dibao_group = gr,
      variable = variable,
      level = lev,
      records = nrow(d),
      persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  do.call(rbind, out)
}

check_nonoverlap <- function(data) {
  # Compare only neighboring periods of the SAME respondent after sorting.
  # This has the same overlap rule as the original, without a full-table scan
  # for every individual.
  d <- data[order(as.character(data$individual_id), data$start, data$stop),
            , drop = FALSE]
  n <- nrow(d)
  if (n <= 1L) return(character(0))
  id <- as.character(d$individual_id)
  bad <- id[-1L] == id[-n] & d$start[-1L] < d$stop[-n]
  unique(id[-1L][bad])
}

print_table_section <- function(title, x, digits = 4) {
  cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 78), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(title, "\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 78), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")

  if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) {
    cat("No result available.\n")
  } else {
    print(x, row.names = FALSE, digits = digits)
  }
}

add_sheet <- function(wb, name, x) {
  addWorksheet(wb, name)
  writeData(wb, name, x)
}

# ---------------------------
# 2. Read and validate common Method A data (including first-valid HUKOU)
# ---------------------------
common <- readRDS(COMMON_RDS)

required_common_objects <- c(
  "analysis_intervals",
  "income_cutoffs",
  "hukou_qa"
)

missing_common_objects <- setdiff(
  required_common_objects,
  names(common)
)

if (length(missing_common_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The common RDS is missing required object(s): ",
    paste(missing_common_objects, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

dat_all <- common$analysis_intervals

required_columns <- c(
  "individual_id",
  "household_id",
  "dibao_group",
  "start",
  "stop",
  "event",
  "person_years",
  "sex",
  "income_tertile",
  "long_mean_household_income_pc",
  "marriage_status",
  "living_children",
  "coresident_child",
  "hukou",
  "hukou_fixed",
  "hukou_first_wave",
  "hukou_conflict",
  "age_group"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(dat_all))

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "analysis_intervals is missing required column(s): ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# The updated common RDS stores the HUKOU code and the first-valid wave.
# Validate these fields without altering any Phase 1 cleaning or cutoffs.
raw_hukou <- dat_all$hukou_fixed
if (any(!is.na(raw_hukou) & !(raw_hukou %in% c(1, 2)))) {
  stop("HUKOU raw coding must be 1 (agricultural) or 2 (non-agricultural).")
}
expected_hukou <- ifelse(
  is.na(raw_hukou), NA_character_,
  ifelse(raw_hukou == 1, "Agricultural", "Non-agricultural")
)
if (!identical(as.character(dat_all$hukou), expected_hukou)) {
  stop("The common RDS HUKOU labels do not match the latest Phase 1 coding.")
}
if (any(is.na(raw_hukou) != is.na(dat_all$hukou_first_wave))) {
  stop("HUKOU first-valid-wave and missingness fields are inconsistent.")
}
if (any(!is.na(dat_all$hukou_first_wave) &
        !(dat_all$hukou_first_wave %in% c(2011, 2013, 2015, 2018, 2020)))) {
  stop("Unexpected first-valid HUKOU wave in the common RDS.")
}

# HUKOU is respondent-fixed, even when it changes in later survey waves.
by_person_hukou <- tapply(
  as.character(dat_all$hukou), as.character(dat_all$individual_id),
  function(x) length(unique(x[!is.na(x)]))
)
if (any(by_person_hukou > 1L)) {
  stop("HUKOU differs across intervals for the same respondent.")
}

if (length(common$income_cutoffs) != 2 ||
    any(!is.finite(common$income_cutoffs))) {
  stop("The common RDS does not contain two valid finite income cutoffs.")
}

q1 <- as.numeric(common$income_cutoffs[1])
q2 <- as.numeric(common$income_cutoffs[2])

if (!(q1 < q2)) {
  stop("Income cutoffs are invalid: q1 must be smaller than q2.")
}

# Keep only the two formal analysis groups.
dat_all <- dat_all[
  as.character(dat_all$dibao_group) %in% c("Never", "Ever"),
  , drop = FALSE
]

if (nrow(dat_all) == 0) {
  stop("No Ever/Never analysis intervals found in the common RDS.")
}

# Basic person-period integrity checks.
if (any(is.na(dat_all$start)) || any(is.na(dat_all$stop))) {
  stop("Interaction data contain missing start or stop times.")
}

if (any(dat_all$stop <= dat_all$start)) {
  stop("Interaction data contain stop <= start intervals.")
}

if (any(!dat_all$event %in% c(0, 1))) {
  stop("Interaction data contain event values other than 0/1.")
}

events_per_person <- tapply(
  dat_all$event,
  dat_all$individual_id,
  sum,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

if (any(events_per_person > 1)) {
  stop("At least one participant has more than one death event.")
}

bad_overlap <- check_nonoverlap(dat_all)

if (length(bad_overlap) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Overlapping person-period intervals detected for ",
    length(bad_overlap),
    " participant(s). First IDs: ",
    paste(head(bad_overlap, 10), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# 3. Match the updated Ever/Never model sample definition (HUKOU included)
# ---------------------------
# Marriage Unknown was excluded from BOTH revised separate-group Cox models
# because it created severe sparse/zero-event instability. The interaction
# analysis must therefore use the same rule for both groups.
marriage_unknown_excluded <- dat_all[
  as.character(dat_all$marriage_status) == "Unknown",
  , drop = FALSE
]

after_marriage <- dat_all[
  as.character(dat_all$marriage_status) != "Unknown",
  , drop = FALSE
]

# Exactly match the updated Ever/Never Phase 1 complete-case HUKOU rule.
# HUKOU-missing intervals are excluded ONLY here, never from common data.
hukou_missing_excluded <- after_marriage[
  is.na(after_marriage$hukou), , drop = FALSE
]
dat <- after_marriage[
  !is.na(after_marriage$hukou), , drop = FALSE
]
dat <- droplevels(dat)

# Re-assert factor order and reference categories.
dat$dibao_group <- factor(
  dat$dibao_group,
  levels = c("Never", "Ever")
)

dat$sex <- factor(
  dat$sex,
  levels = c("Male", "Female")
)

dat$income_tertile <- factor(
  dat$income_tertile,
  levels = c("T1", "T2", "T3")
)

dat$marriage_status <- factor(
  dat$marriage_status,
  levels = c(
    "Partnered",
    "Widowed",
    "Separated-Divorced",
    "Never married"
  )
)

dat$living_children <- factor(
  dat$living_children,
  levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+", "Unknown")
)

dat$coresident_child <- factor(
  dat$coresident_child,
  levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")
)

# Same reference as both Phase 1 models: non-agricultural HUKOU.
dat$hukou <- factor(
  dat$hukou,
  levels = c("Non-agricultural", "Agricultural")
)

dat$age_group <- factor(
  dat$age_group,
  levels = c("45-54", "55-64", "65-74", "75-84", "85-94", "95+")
)

# Required modeled fields must be present after filtering/re-leveling.
for (v in c(
  "dibao_group", "sex", "income_tertile", "marriage_status",
  "living_children", "coresident_child", "hukou", "age_group"
)) {
  if (any(is.na(dat[[v]]))) {
    stop("Unexpected missing/invalid value in final interaction variable: ", v)
  }
}

if (length(unique(dat$dibao_group)) != 2) {
  stop("Both Never and Ever groups are required for interaction testing.")
}

if (sum(dat$event, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
  stop("No death events remain in the interaction analysis data.")
}

# Guard against silently using a common RDS that does not match the RDS files
# of the already-fitted Phase 1 models. Both studies must use the same rows.
phase1_sample_check <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
  d <- dat[as.character(dat$dibao_group) == gr, , drop = FALSE]
  m <- if (gr == "Ever") ever_results_object$main_model else
    never_results_object$main_model
  model_n <- as.integer(m$n)
  model_deaths <- as.integer(m$nevent)
  data_n <- nrow(d)
  data_deaths <- sum(d$event)
  data.frame(
    dibao_group = gr,
    interaction_intervals = data_n,
    phase1_model_intervals = model_n,
    interaction_deaths = data_deaths,
    phase1_model_deaths = model_deaths,
    matches_phase1 = data_n == model_n && data_deaths == model_deaths,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
if (any(is.na(phase1_sample_check$matches_phase1)) ||
    !all(phase1_sample_check$matches_phase1)) {
  stop("Interaction analysis rows/events do not match the Phase 1 Cox ",
       "samples. Check that common/Ever/Never RDS files were generated ",
       "from the SAME updated input files and models.")
}

if (length(unique(as.character(dat$hukou))) != 2L) {
  stop("Both HUKOU categories must appear in the pooled Cox sample.")
}

# 4. Sample summary and QA
# ---------------------------
sample_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
    d <- dat[as.character(dat$dibao_group) == gr, , drop = FALSE]

    data.frame(
      dibao_group = gr,
      persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      households = length(unique(d$household_id)),
      person_intervals = nrow(d),
      person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
      death_events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

marriage_unknown_exclusion_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
    d <- marriage_unknown_excluded[
      as.character(marriage_unknown_excluded$dibao_group) == gr,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    data.frame(
      dibao_group = gr,
      rule = "Marriage status Unknown excluded from formal interaction models",
      records_excluded = nrow(d),
      persons_affected = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      events_excluded = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_years_excluded = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

hukou_missing_exclusion_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
    d <- hukou_missing_excluded[
      as.character(hukou_missing_excluded$dibao_group) == gr,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
    data.frame(
      dibao_group = gr,
      rule = "First non-missing HUKOU absent in all waves; exclude from Cox",
      records_excluded = nrow(d),
      persons_affected = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      events_excluded = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_years_excluded = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

income_cutoff_table <- data.frame(
  cutoff = c("33.333%", "66.667%"),
  value = c(q1, q2),
  method = "Same Method A common cutoffs generated by revised Ever script",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

qa_variables <- c(
  "sex",
  "income_tertile",
  "marriage_status",
  "living_children",
  "coresident_child",
  "hukou",
  "age_group"
)

cell_qa <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(qa_variables, function(v) make_group_level_qa(dat, v))
)

sparse_qa <- cell_qa[
  cell_qa$events < MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL,
  , drop = FALSE
]

# ---------------------------
# 5. Define primary and sensitivity interaction specifications
# ---------------------------
# PRIMARY substantive interaction levels.
# Unknown missingness categories remain in the adjustment set but are not
# included in the primary substantive heterogeneity test.
primary_specs <- list(
  sex = c("Female"),
  income_tertile = c("T2", "T3"),
  marriage_status = c("Widowed", "Separated-Divorced", "Never married"),
  living_children = c("1", "2", "3+"),
  coresident_child = c("Yes"),
  hukou = c("Agricultural")
)

# ALL-LEVEL sensitivity interaction levels.
# Here Unknown is additionally interacted for children and coresidence.
all_level_specs <- list(
  sex = c("Female"),
  income_tertile = c("T2", "T3"),
  marriage_status = c("Widowed", "Separated-Divorced", "Never married"),
  living_children = c("1", "2", "3+", "Unknown"),
  coresident_child = c("Yes", "Unknown"),
  hukou = c("Agricultural")
)

# ---------------------------
# 6. Verify primary interaction cells before fitting
# ---------------------------
primary_eligibility <- data.frame()

for (target in names(primary_specs)) {
  for (lev in primary_specs[[target]]) {
    z <- cell_qa[
      cell_qa$variable == target &
        cell_qa$level == lev &
        cell_qa$dibao_group %in% c("Never", "Ever"),
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    never_events <- if (any(z$dibao_group == "Never")) {
      z$events[z$dibao_group == "Never"][1]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    ever_events <- if (any(z$dibao_group == "Ever")) {
      z$events[z$dibao_group == "Ever"][1]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    eligible <- !is.na(never_events) && !is.na(ever_events) &&
      never_events >= MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL &&
      ever_events >= MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL

    primary_eligibility <- rbind(
      primary_eligibility,
      data.frame(
        factor = target,
        level = lev,
        Never_events = never_events,
        Ever_events = ever_events,
        eligible = eligible,
        rule = paste0(
          ">=", MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL,
          " deaths in both Dibao groups"
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
}

if (any(!primary_eligibility$eligible)) {
  bad <- primary_eligibility[!primary_eligibility$eligible, , drop = FALSE]
  stop(
    "At least one PRIMARY substantive interaction level does not meet the ",
    "prespecified event-count stability rule. Inspect primary_eligibility.\n",
    paste(
      paste0(
        bad$factor, " / ", bad$level,
        " (Never events=", bad$Never_events,
        ", Ever events=", bad$Ever_events, ")"
      ),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

# 7. Function to fit one-factor-at-a-time interaction models
# ---------------------------
fit_interaction_set <- function(data, specs, analysis_label) {
  models <- list()
  block_tests <- data.frame()
  level_HRs <- data.frame()
  coefficients <- data.frame()
  ph_tables <- data.frame()
  ph_objects <- list()
  warnings_table <- data.frame()

  for (target in names(specs)) {
    tmp <- add_interaction_columns(
      data,
      target,
      specs[[target]]
    )

    model_data <- tmp$data
    int_names <- tmp$interaction_names
    level_map <- tmp$level_map
    form <- build_formula(int_names)

    fit_obj <- fit_cox_with_warnings(form, model_data)
    fit <- fit_obj$fit

    model_name <- paste0(analysis_label, "_", target)
    models[[target]] <- fit

    # Robust block Wald test: H0 = all interaction coefficients for target = 0.
    block <- wald_block(fit, int_names)
    block$analysis <- analysis_label
    block$factor <- target
    block$n_interaction_terms <- length(int_names)

    block_tests <- rbind(
      block_tests,
      block[, c(
        "analysis", "factor", "chisq", "df", "p_value",
        "n_interaction_terms", "status"
      )]
    )

    # All model coefficients.
    cc <- extract_cox_results(fit)
    cc$analysis <- analysis_label
    cc$factor_tested <- target

    coefficients <- rbind(
      coefficients,
      cc[, c(
        "analysis", "factor_tested",
        setdiff(names(cc), c("analysis", "factor_tested"))
      )]
    )

    # Level-specific Never HR, Ever HR, and Ever/Never HR ratio.
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(level_map))) {
      rr <- make_level_hr_row(
        fit = fit,
        variable = target,
        level = level_map$level[j],
        interaction_term = level_map$interaction_term[j]
      )
      rr$analysis <- analysis_label

      level_HRs <- rbind(
        level_HRs,
        rr[, c("analysis", setdiff(names(rr), "analysis"))]
      )
    }

    # PH diagnostics.
    ph_diag <- run_ph_diagnostic(
      form,
      model_data,
      fit,
      model_name
    )

    ph_objects[[target]] <- ph_diag$object
    ph_tables <- rbind(ph_tables, ph_diag$table)

    # Capture coxph warnings.
    if (length(fit_obj$warnings) > 0) {
      warnings_table <- rbind(
        warnings_table,
        data.frame(
          analysis = analysis_label,
          model = target,
          warning = fit_obj$warnings,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      )
    }
  }

  list(
    models = models,
    block_tests = block_tests,
    level_HRs = level_HRs,
    coefficients = coefficients,
    ph_tables = ph_tables,
    ph_objects = ph_objects,
    warnings = warnings_table
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# 8. PRIMARY one-factor-at-a-time substantive interaction models
# ---------------------------
primary_results <- fit_interaction_set(
  data = dat,
  specs = primary_specs,
  analysis_label = "Primary_Substantive"
)

primary_level_readable <- make_readable_interaction(
  primary_results$level_HRs
)

# ---------------------------
# 9. ALL-LEVEL one-factor-at-a-time sensitivity models
# ---------------------------
all_level_results <- fit_interaction_set(
  data = dat,
  specs = all_level_specs,
  analysis_label = "Sensitivity_AllLevels"
)

all_level_readable <- make_readable_interaction(
  all_level_results$level_HRs
)

# ---------------------------
# 10. Full interaction model helper
# ---------------------------
fit_full_interaction_model <- function(data, specs, analysis_label) {
  full_data <- data
  full_blocks <- list()
  full_level_map <- list()
  all_interaction_names <- character(0)

  for (target in names(specs)) {
    tmp <- add_interaction_columns(
      full_data,
      target,
      specs[[target]]
    )

    full_data <- tmp$data
    full_blocks[[target]] <- tmp$interaction_names
    full_level_map[[target]] <- tmp$level_map
    all_interaction_names <- c(
      all_interaction_names,
      tmp$interaction_names
    )
  }

  full_formula <- build_formula(all_interaction_names)
  fit_obj <- fit_cox_with_warnings(full_formula, full_data)
  fit <- fit_obj$fit

  block_tests <- data.frame()
  level_HRs <- data.frame()

  for (target in names(specs)) {
    int_names <- full_blocks[[target]]
    block <- wald_block(fit, int_names)
    block$analysis <- analysis_label
    block$factor <- target
    block$n_interaction_terms <- length(int_names)

    block_tests <- rbind(
      block_tests,
      block[, c(
        "analysis", "factor", "chisq", "df", "p_value",
        "n_interaction_terms", "status"
      )]
    )

    lm <- full_level_map[[target]]

    for (j in seq_len(nrow(lm))) {
      rr <- make_level_hr_row(
        fit = fit,
        variable = target,
        level = lm$level[j],
        interaction_term = lm$interaction_term[j]
      )
      rr$analysis <- analysis_label

      level_HRs <- rbind(
        level_HRs,
        rr[, c("analysis", setdiff(names(rr), "analysis"))]
      )
    }
  }

  coefficients <- extract_cox_results(fit)
  coefficients$analysis <- analysis_label
  coefficients <- coefficients[, c(
    "analysis", setdiff(names(coefficients), "analysis")
  )]

  ph_diag <- run_ph_diagnostic(
    full_formula,
    full_data,
    fit,
    analysis_label
  )

  warning_table <- if (length(fit_obj$warnings) > 0) {
    data.frame(
      analysis = analysis_label,
      model = "Full interaction model",
      warning = fit_obj$warnings,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }

  list(
    model = fit,
    formula = full_formula,
    block_tests = block_tests,
    level_HRs = level_HRs,
    level_HRs_readable = make_readable_interaction(level_HRs),
    coefficients = coefficients,
    ph = ph_diag$object,
    ph_table = ph_diag$table,
    warnings = warning_table
  )
}

# 11. Full substantive interaction sensitivity model
# ---------------------------
full_substantive <- fit_full_interaction_model(
  data = dat,
  specs = primary_specs,
  analysis_label = "Full_Substantive"
)

# ---------------------------
# 12. Full all-level sensitivity model
# ---------------------------
full_all_levels <- fit_full_interaction_model(
  data = dat,
  specs = all_level_specs,
  analysis_label = "Full_AllLevels"
)

# ---------------------------
# 13. Interaction-cell QA and sensitivity flags
# ---------------------------
# The all-level sensitivity model may contain low-event Unknown categories.
# Flag them explicitly; do not silently interpret them as stable substantive
# effects.
all_level_interaction_qa <- data.frame()

for (target in names(all_level_specs)) {
  for (lev in all_level_specs[[target]]) {
    z <- cell_qa[
      cell_qa$variable == target &
        cell_qa$level == lev &
        cell_qa$dibao_group %in% c("Never", "Ever"),
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    never_events <- if (any(z$dibao_group == "Never")) {
      z$events[z$dibao_group == "Never"][1]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    ever_events <- if (any(z$dibao_group == "Ever")) {
      z$events[z$dibao_group == "Ever"][1]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    all_level_interaction_qa <- rbind(
      all_level_interaction_qa,
      data.frame(
        factor = target,
        level = lev,
        Never_events = never_events,
        Ever_events = ever_events,
        low_event_flag =
          is.na(never_events) || is.na(ever_events) ||
          never_events < MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL ||
          ever_events < MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
}

# ---------------------------
# 14. Side-by-side independent group results (descriptive only)
# ---------------------------
# These are NOT the formal interaction results. They are included only to help
# the reader compare the separately fitted Ever and Never main Cox models.
independent_group_comparison <- data.frame()

if (!is.null(ever_results_object) &&
    !is.null(ever_results_object$main_results_readable) &&
    !is.null(never_results_object$main_results_readable)) {

  ev <- ever_results_object$main_results_readable
  nv <- never_results_object$main_results_readable

  ev2 <- ev[, c("comparison", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")]
  nv2 <- nv[, c("comparison", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")]

  names(ev2)[-1] <- paste0("Ever_", names(ev2)[-1])
  names(nv2)[-1] <- paste0("Never_", names(nv2)[-1])

  independent_group_comparison <- merge(
    nv2,
    ev2,
    by = "comparison",
    all = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# 15. Combine warnings
# ---------------------------
model_warning_table <- rbind(
  primary_results$warnings,
  all_level_results$warnings,
  full_substantive$warnings,
  full_all_levels$warnings
)

if (nrow(model_warning_table) == 0) {

    analysis = "None",
    model = "None",
    warning = "No coxph warnings captured",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# 16. PH diagnostic PDFs

# One PDF for each PRIMARY substantive interaction model.
for (target in names(primary_results$models)) {
  ph <- primary_results$ph_objects[[target]]

  if (!inherits(ph, "cox_zph_error")) {
    pdf(file.path(
      OUTPUT_DIR,
      paste0("A_Interaction_PH_Primary_", safe_name(target), ".pdf")
    ))
    try(plot(ph), silent = TRUE)
    dev.off()
  }
}

}

  try(plot(full_all_levels$ph), silent = TRUE)
  dev.off()
}

# 17. Save R model/results object
# ---------------------------
saveRDS(
```
